143. Attribute Training (1)
In the Viy Palace, the top executives of the Geum-Pengi company reported to Jin about the business status.
By now, Geum-Pengi's cosmetics have become almost "irreplaceable" items.
Not only color cosmetics, but they also developed various products for the skin and clothing, so people of all ages and genders worldwide were using Geum-Pengi's products.
It has become a product representing the era.

"Who would have known that the flowers and snowflakes from Viy would be so good for human skin? If it were a world where only making money was enough, as a partner, I'm already close to the top on a personal level. Let's dedicate this glory to the great, beautiful, and omnipotent Talaris!"
Jin nodded at Pengi's words.
"How's the development of magic tools going?"
"We're still pouring water into a bottomless barrel. But we have a lot of money, right? If we keep pouring like this, some results will come out eventually. Money doesn't lie."
The money earned from the top business not only fattened Jin and his colleagues' finances but was also invested heavily in the development of magic tools.
It was for changing the market monopolized by Jipley someday.
As time passes and the world develops, Jipley's influence becomes more robust, while Runecandle has diminished. To stop the monopoly and decline, Runecandle needed something other than power.
"However, recruiting researchers or magical engineers isn't easy. We can only rely on people with huge guts to secretly work with us, excluding the top talents. It's inevitable that it's slow."
To defend Tican, to analyze the machines of the 2nd Magitower, and to develop magic tools, they desperately needed a real genius engineer.
Of course, the probability that one engineer's abilities would be great enough to solve all of these problems was meager.
However, if they couldn't find someone, the work wouldn't progress properly.
"I'll actively look for people from now on, so please continue to work hard."
"Then, don't worry, partner. Oh, and the guy who bought clothes from us on our recommendation, Nodav Sarssang. Was his real name Sandra Jipley?"
"Yeah. If I had told her that her clothes were not good, she would have tried to annihilate all of you."

"A fierce customer, we'll have to be careful with her orders in the future. Oh, and I didn't write it in the report. We tried to include water-tailed kids in the partner advertisement as a test. People reacted positively saying they're cute. Take a look at this."
When Pengi showed the advertisement design, Jin burst into laughter and headed to the training ground. Talaris was waiting for him.

"Huh, it seems like Siron really adored Meri. Looking at this carefully crafted vision document. Well, if she can properly train with the right direction, she could be one of the top talents who could become the strongest of your generation in Runecandle. Excluding Luna, that is."
Talaris was looking at the vision document left by Siron.
As soon as Jin entered the training ground, his eyes changed.
"I was going to help lightly, but seeing your serious face makes me feel a bit burdened. Uh-huh, it seems this mission was quite shocking to you in many ways?"
"My desire to become stronger is always full, but the Sota Desert was particularly shocking."

"Is it because of that Hedorah, the superhuman? I've been thinking about that person too, but no one comes to mind. As I mentioned earlier, the most likely possibility is that it's the warrior your father saved in the Black Sea."
"It's not just because of that tower keeper, but overall, I felt powerless."

"Well, they say our son-in-law's judgment was great. If it weren't for you, the mission would never have been successful, according to the handsome brother. Well... In my opinion, Runecandel would have had a safety net in place in case you guys failed."
"If my martial arts skills were better, the Black Knight, Jane, would not have died."
"On the contrary, if it weren't for you, that Mon, the Black Knight, would have met his death too. You definitely did well. And now, at only twenty years old, how much stronger do you want to be?"
"I think I should be as strong as my father was at my age."
"Are you sure you're not stronger than Syron at twenty?"
"There's no way."
"Useless impatience will only eat you up in the end."

"I've heard that story a few times before. I know. That's why I'm planning to systematically relieve this impatient feeling. First, I'll master the martial arts, and after sorting out the situation in general, I'll start closed-door training."
"Closed-door training?"
"I'm going to Lafrarosa, the world of the Demon King tribe. I don't plan to come out until I reach the 10th rank."

"You'll be out soon. Huh, we need to find a way to bring the Demon King tribe back from the dead world... Our son-in-law is busy. Your head must be exploding. There's nothing better than training at times like this. In particular, there's no better technique to polish than Runecandel's 5th martial arts, the Lightspeed Thrust, to cool your head."
Runecandel's final moves, martial arts, and the Ohs can only be used by pure-blooded people who are born with a blessed body. Therefore, if you are not a pureblood, you cannot teach them either.
However, Talris knew the 5th martial arts Lightspeed Thrust better than most purebloods. She was the person who had crossed swords with Syron Runecandel the most in the world.

"Among Runecandel's martial arts, I can't teach you the complicated ones, even if I'm the one teaching. I can't understand martial arts like Aura Walking or Gathering, which can only be used by pure-blooded Runecandels because their body structure is different. But the 5th martial arts are not like that. It's very simple, son-in-law."
"Simple?"
"It's just an insanely fast thrust. Apart from complex ones like the 3rd martial arts Gold Circle, most of Runecandel's swords are like that."
"Just an insanely fast thrust..."
"It's no different for other warriors who can't imitate Runecandel's swords. It's because they don't have a body that can support that tremendous acceleration and explosive power."
Talris's right hand gathered a pure white chill, forming a sword. It was the Ice Blade.
"But if you're an excellent warrior like me, you can imitate it like this. Watch closely."
Flash-!
The Ice Blade's edge tore through the air in the training hall. A dazzling aura flashed, and space was distorted and split where the sword tip had passed.
There was no preparatory movement, but Talris's thrust was surpassing the martial arts that Meri had displayed.
The range of the attack was certainly smaller, but that was actually a higher level. The power was minimized and completely focused on a single point.
'Amazing. If Talris unleashes this thrust at full power against me, I probably... won't be able to react.'
Moreover, Talris hadn't even used her full power. Jin was sure she could perform an even more impressive thrust.
"How is it? Similar, right?"
"It's not just similar, it's far superior to what Lady Meri showed."
"Of course. It's the same technique after all. It's not comparable to the original one your father uses, though. Ah, my waist. My shoulder feels like it's going to tear."
"Are you okay?"
"Trying to follow Runecandle's swordsmanship is a bad idea. That's why I can't use it in actual combat. I would end up getting more hurt than the enemy."
Of course, the vast majority of warriors wouldn't be able to handle the thrust Talris just demonstrated.
However, if Talris fought a warrior of a similar level, this thrust would definitely be a disadvantage.
Naturally, there is an enormous gap between superhumans like Talris and Jin. There is a wall that cannot be expressed with simple numbers like 1-star, 2-star.
'Even knowing that fact gives me goosebumps. If Talris decides to kill me...'
Within 10 minutes.
It would be over. This certain belief made him feel bitter, even though he had no choice but to accept it.
Reading Jin's thoughts, Talris gave a faint smile.
"If I were to try and kill you with my full power without any interference, it would be over in 5 minutes."
"I thought it would be 10 minutes, but that's even less time."

"The area where I stand may seem far away. It actually is far away. But if we compare it to stairs... it's just a few steps difference. And I don't know about Si-ron, but when I was 20 years old, I was at a lower position than you."
Jin didn't believe it, but it was true.

"Besides, your growth rate is still rapidly increasing. Is it really short to withstand me for 5 minutes? Considering the density of time we've both experienced, it's rather unfair for me, son-in-law."
It wasn't wrong. Jin slightly bowed his head.
"I apologize if my arrogance has offended you, Talris."
"It's a reasonable arrogance, so I'm not offended. Now, let's see your Light-Speed Thrust. I'll help you understand the theory that Si-ron deliberately made difficult very easily."

The manuscript for Meri was carefully written, but it was actually more difficult to understand. Hoping that Meri would gain a deeper understanding of sword theory, Si-ron had placed traps in each paragraph.
Swoosh-!
Bradamente emitted a brilliant light. The condensed aura left a shimmering afterimage, and a sharp band of aura was drawn along the diagonal line where the blade had reached.
It was a light-speed thrust almost identical to the one Talris had just demonstrated. Both speed and power were greater than Meri's light-speed thrust.

Although he had occasionally studied the manuscript, he had hardly practiced it directly. However, the reason Jin could perform the light-speed thrust in just one attempt was because of Talris's help.
'The moment I swung my sword, Talris's power... assisted me.'
The core of the light-speed thrust is, of course, acceleration. There were a total of seven accelerations using aura in just one sword-swinging motion.
Talris assisted Jin with her own power for all seven, so that he could feel the precise moments.
'Is it even possible...? To assist at the exact moment matching my speed?'
Doubts may arise, but there's no need for skepticism. He had already experienced it directly. Talris was smiling as if she knew he'd be surprised.
"Now you can accurately understand the acceleration points that were difficult to grasp with the complicated theory, right?"
"Yes, Talris."

"It means that you should not release the aura all at once, but divide it into seven and do it at the exact moment. Ordinary warriors can't do that because of their low aura responsiveness, and even if they manage to do it with good luck, their shoulders and waist would be shattered."
Jin immediately prepared for the next practice.
"In a day or two, with my assistance, you'll get a better sense of it. If you can make your body remember that sensation exactly..."
Whoosh-!
While Talris was explaining, Jin swung his sword again.
This time, there was no assistance from Talris. She didn't expect Jin to perform a second thrust before she even finished speaking.
But Jin was captivated.

He was completely intoxicated by the sensation that Talris had awakened, and unknowingly performed a second thrust. The simple pleasure of the solution was so exhilarating that he didn't even hear Talris's ongoing explanation.
And his second light-speed thrust, which he executed without assistance, was almost 90% similar to the first one he performed with help.
The moment his second light-speed thrust scraped the ice wall of the training ground, Jin opened his eyes wide in surprise, realizing that he had acted unconsciously, ignoring Talris's words.
Talris, on the other hand, blinked her eyes in shock at the result Jin achieved with 'just one' assistance.
